Backend: 55/55 tests pass (1 skipped — Slack-not-configured, expected). All 14 new Phase 15 tests pass: contact text-only (queued/sent), with-attachment (id+ext+size+original_name), oversize 413, list excludes stored_path, invalid priority 422, AB track 200/422, AB stats CTR aggregation, lead segments endpoint, score+segment fields, segment filter, mock annotations 2-5 deterministic, 404 unknown, Nifty workspaces list, 400/200 on save. Frontend: client portal Contact tab (data-testid='portal-tab-contact') opens 'client-contact-panel' with all 5 form testids (subject/body/priority/file/submit). Text-only submission returned success toast 'Message received'. /tour AB variants verified across all three localStorage values — 'header' shows only tour-header-cta, 'hero' shows only tour-hero-cta, 'sticky' shows only tour-sticky-cta sticky bar with dismiss X (matrix is mutually exclusive). /admin/integrations renders ab-stats-card and nifty-workspaces-panel. /admin/lead-magnets renders lead-scoring-panel + all 4 filter testids (leads-filter-segment/magnet/source/score). /admin/approvals renders admin-approval-annotations-{id} button per row; clicking opens approval-annotations-dialog with vertical timeline of resolved/open status icons and anchor coords.
critical_code_review_comments: contact_routes.py — Solid scope isolation: GET /clients/me/contact projects out stored_path before responding so the on-disk uuid path never leaks. Attachment download is owner-only by joining contact.client_id with current_client.id. 10MB cap enforced via Spool/streaming check before write to /app/backend/uploads — good (no full buffer of oversize file).
ab_test_routes.py — Tight Pydantic enum on variant rejects unknown variants with 422 before any DB write. Admin stats endpoint computes CTR = clicks/impressions with divide-by-zero guard.

leads_routes.py — _score_lead + _segment_for_score is simple/deterministic and uses source URL keyword heuristics (e.g., 'seo', 'pricing'). /admin/leads/segments returns aggregated counts in O(1) post-fetch — fine for current scale but consider Mongo aggregation if leads cross 10k.

approval_studio_client.py — _mock_annotations_for(project_id) seeds Python random with hash(project_id) so the same approval always returns the same 2-5 comment thread. Test relied on this determinism and it held across two runs.

PublicSandboxTour.jsx — Variant assignment reads localStorage 'bloom_ab_tour_cta' first then falls back to a hash of (sessionStorage tour_session_id || crypto.randomUUID) % 3. Each variant CTA has a unique data-testid; non-active variants are unmounted (not just hidden), so DOM is clean for analytics.

Minor (no fix needed): The sticky variant bottom bar uses fixed positioning with bottom-0; on /tour with no scroll yet it overlays the hero. Functional, but could add a small entry animation/threshold (e.g. show after 25% scroll) to reduce intrusion — owner call.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all data-testids present, all 3 AB variants render mutually exclusive, contact submit returns success toast, annotations dialog renders timeline with resolved/open pills
